name: select-item
title: Select Item
description: A selectable option row: a pointer hovers it, presses it, and it commits as selected with a check, inside a small option list.
useWhen: A dropdown or listbox demo needs a single option being highlighted and chosen.
Explaining hover, press and selected states of an option.
avoidWhen: The whole dropdown opening and picking is wanted: use select.
An action row in a menu (no selection): use dropdown-menu-item.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Other options
variables.description: Comma-separated options shown idle around it.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the interaction. Above 1 it finishes early and holds the last state.

variables.description: Skip the theme background so the control sits on your own scene.
